shared_entry_point_rule: Where two featured sites name the same Coastal Commission access point, the app draws both blocks in this file's order. Neither hides the other, and no site is preferred: the Commission publishes one access point and divers use two names for the water off it.
draft_status: DRAFT — R59 Lane F. Nothing here is confirmed by the owner.; owner floor for typical_dive_depth applied 2026-09-22
rules: Every entry note is a statement this lane actually read on a published agency page, with that page's URL and the date it was read. No forum lore, no guesses, no 'locals say'.
Entry-point ids, names and coordinates are the California Coastal Commission's own, copied from the dataset the app already carries. No coordinate was invented.
Station ids (CDIP buoy, CDIP MOP point, pier shore station, CO-OPS tide station, NDBC buoy) are null placeholders for R59 Lane S.
Every field the owner must confirm from his own knowledge carries owner_review: true.
No person's name appears in any note.

Hosts that refused are listed in derived-metadata-method.md §7; a site with no entry note usually has one because its agency's host refused or its terms forbid automated reading (California State Parks above all).

typical_dive_depth on every site without a site-specific figure is the owner's floor of 2026-09-22 ('at least 10 feet'); it prints as a floor, never as a measurement, and a site-specific owner figure replaces it.
typical_dive_depth_floor_source: owner_statement 2026-09-22: 'For typical dive depths that are not listed from the coast put at least 10 feet as the typical dive depth.' A site-specific depth from the owner replaces this floor when he gives one.
derived_caution: exposure_word describes coastline geometry only. It is NOT a judgement about whether to get in the water: Monastery Beach reads 'sheltered' on this geometry. bottom_natsur is the nature of surface NOAA charts nearest the probe point, at the distance given — not the bottom under the diver.
kelp_year_absent_reason: The kelp canopy behind these figures was measured from CDFW's BIOS ds2799 layer, whose own description states that multiple years of kelp mapping have been compiled into a single coastwide data set. That layer publishes no survey year per polygon, so none is printed here. CDFW's annual aerial-survey files carry the year in the file name and are what a later derivation should read.
link_policy_rule: Every URL this file offers the reader is a LINK and nothing else: the app never requests these pages, never embeds them and never reads a value off them. Each host carries a row below saying on what basis it may be linked to. A cam page or a fish-report page may only be added here with a row of its own; none is listed today because no lane has read a policy for one.
